authority: Owner request in this task authorizes the public dashboard update with verified fare averages; it does not approve new financial analysis.
null_policy: Exclude missing amounts from each mean; retain separate sample counts. Volaris points are not applicable.
privacy: Publish only comparable aggregate groups. No spreadsheet IDs, individual flight IDs or schedules.
redemption: Keep points, regular cash final, redemption cash final and redemption taxes independent. Never calculate net point value without final redemption cash.
preservation: Replay the existing approval/source chain and preserve all inherited data and approval identities byte for byte.
